description: Change a toll-free verification: send only the fields to change. Allowed while draft, in_review (until it goes to the carriers) and rejected; after a rejection, fix what it asks for, then submit again.

advertising.description: Whether the messages advertise a product or service.

brand_email.description: The business's own email, for its customers: the HELP reply and the hosted opt-in page name it.

business_name.description: The legal name, as on the IRS EIN letter, optionally with "d/b/a" and the brand your messages carry.

contact_first_name.description: First name of the person the carriers can contact about this program.

ein.description: The EIN (US), matching the legal name; elsewhere the business registration number.

fortune_500.description: The company is in the Fortune 500.

help_reply.description: The reply to HELP: names the business and how to reach it. Omit to keep ours.

monthly_volume.description: How many texts a month this program sends.

multiple_numbers_reason.description: Why the program needs more than one number (one per store, say). Required with more than one number.

numbers.description: Your live toll-free numbers this program texts from, E.164. One per business unless multiple_numbers_reason says why.

opt_in_description.description: How people opt in, step by step. At least 40 characters.

opt_in_url.description: The opt-in page. With none of your own we make you a hosted one.

phones_in_messages.description: Phone numbers your messages include, or "None".

previous_content.description: Sample messages from the previous service (not new only).

previous_numbers.description: The numbers it used (not new only).

stop_reply.description: The reply to STOP: names the business and says they are unsubscribed. Omit to keep ours.

terms_url.description: The terms page, with the SMS program terms.

use_case_summary.description: What the program sends, to whom and why. At least 40 characters.

volume_basis.description: existing: what it sends today. projecting: an estimate.

name: update_toll_free_verification
title: Update toll free verification
